Terms of Service

Effective October 14, 2026 · Beta

These Terms are an agreement between you and No Seeds Dating. By creating an account or using No Seeds, you agree to them and to our Privacy Policy. No Seeds is in beta, so features may change and things may break.

Who can join

  • You are at least 18 years old and single.
  • You have no children of any age, and you do not want biological, adopted or step-children.
  • No Seeds is built for Black singles. Everyone who shares our community values and follows these Terms is welcome.
  • You have not been removed from No Seeds before.

Profile review

We review every profile before other members can see it. We may approve it, ask for changes, or decline it. Approval is not an endorsement of any member and is not a background check.

The No Seeds Pledge

When you join, you confirm your pledge answers are true. You agree to be honest about your relationship history and your childfree choice, and never to pressure anyone to change theirs. False pledge answers are grounds for removal.

Community rules

You agree not to:

  • Lie about who you are, your age, your relationship status, or whether you have children.
  • Harass, threaten, stalk, demean or discriminate against anyone.
  • Send sexual content to anyone who has not clearly asked for it, or share anyone's intimate images without consent.
  • Ask for money, gifts or financial details, or promote any business, scheme or website.
  • Post photos that are not of you, or that show children, nudity or violence.
  • Use No Seeds if you are a registered sex offender or have been convicted of a violent or sexual crime.
  • Copy or collect other members' information, use bots, or try to get around blocks, reviews or removals.

Reporting and blocking

Use Report, Unmatch or Block from any chat. We review every report and may remove content or accounts, and contact law enforcement when someone's safety is at risk.

Your content

You own the photos and words you post. You allow No Seeds to store, display and resize them only to run the app while your account is open, and for a reasonable time afterward for safety records. Only post what you have the right to post. We may remove anything that breaks these Terms.

Date planner

The date planner suggests public places using information from third parties such as Google. We do not own, inspect or endorse those places, and details such as hours may be wrong. You decide whether and where to meet.

No background checks

NO SEEDS DOES NOT CONDUCT CRIMINAL BACKGROUND CHECKS OR IDENTITY VERIFICATION ON ITS MEMBERS.

Profile review is not a background check. You are responsible for your own safety. Please read our Safety page before meeting anyone.

Ending your membership

You can delete your account at any time. We may suspend or remove an account that breaks these Terms or puts others at risk.

Disclaimers and limits

No Seeds is a free beta provided "as is." We do not promise you will find a match, that the app will always work, or that other members are who they say they are. To the fullest extent the law allows, No Seeds Dating is not liable for indirect or consequential losses, or for anyone's conduct on or off the app.

Changes and contact

We may update these Terms during the beta and will tell you in the app before important changes take effect. If you have a concern, please contact us first at thegiftedbystarr@gmail.com so we can try to resolve it.
